scope: ERC pin type recommendations for auxiliary devices; no connectivity or physical pin-number changes

type_notes.open_collector: KiCad token used for open-drain outputs as well as open-collector outputs.
type_notes.U2.1_2_3_and_U7.5: U2 pins1/2/3 are physical terminals of one switch-node output on BUCK3V3_SW. For ERC keep pin1 power_out and model duplicate pins2/3 passive. U7.5 remains power_out. These are switching nodes, not regulated DC rail labels; inductors remain passive.
type_notes.U10.5: Native library numbering for unnumbered manufacturer EPAD; retained and typed power_in for required GND connection.
type_notes.U4.4_U9.4_U11.5: Manufacturer allows these NC terminals to be tied to a supply/ground as described; passive preserves that permission rather than forbidding connections.
type_notes.U11.3: SDO output or SA0 address input; bidirectional represents both roles.
type_notes.U11.11: INT2 output or external clock input in the supported special mode; bidirectional.
type_notes.U11.7: RES must connect to GND; power_in is a conservative schematic ground-connection model.
type_notes.U12.4: CT sources the timing-capacitor charge; output follows manufacturer I/O table.
type_notes.U12.5: QOD is an internally resistive switched discharge path to GND. Model passive for ERC to represent this analog terminal and the datasheet-supported direct VOUT tie; it is not a power source. Supersedes the initial open_collector abstraction.
type_notes.J1_J2_J3: Connector contacts are passive boundary connections; the peripheral on either side determines drive direction.
type_notes.LED1: Both pins passive. Reconciled physical pad 1=STATUS_LED_K and 2=STATUS_LED_A agree with footprint cathode marking. Duplicate-name EDIF aliases are not physical pin numbers.

findings.details: Native SW pin 5 is powerIn; recommended power_out.
Effective Flux board has footprint copper corrections; cached source payload alone does not reproduce them.

resolved_findings.details: Initial audit inferred physical pad numbers from duplicate-name EDIF ordering. Native canonical net anchor establishes pad 1=STATUS_LED_K; remaining group member gives pad 2=STATUS_LED_A. Source polarity agrees with footprint; probable defect finding withdrawn.

model_adjustments.reason: Same internal switch output with multiple physical terminals; retain one ERC driver and passive duplicates.
Duplicate terminals of the internal SMPS switch output; recommendation for generator MCU model, not inserted into auxiliary pin_types.
Analog QOD discharge terminal tied directly to VOUT, explicitly supported by TI TPS22918 p13 section8.3.2.

power_flag_reasons.SYS_IN: Supply downstream of passive MOSFET/diode paths.
power_flag_reasons.BAT_PLUS: External battery source; no initial undriven-power report at passive endpoint, but source annotation is appropriate.

erc_review.validation_required: Rerun ERC after specific model/source annotations and compare exported netlist against reconciled physical connectivity.
